title: Color Gate Jam
description: Slide chunky colored blocks out through matching gates on the board edge. Plan the order, beat the move limit and clear five hand-built jams.
controls: Drag a block up, down, left or right; it glides until something stops it. A block touching a same-color gate that fits its width slides out. Clear the board before moves run out.

zh-CN.title: 彩门滑块
zh-CN.description: 把彩色滑块从同色的出口滑出棋盘。想清楚先后顺序，在步数用完前清空五个手工设计的拥堵关卡。
zh-CN.controls: 按住色块上下左右拖动，它会一直滑到被挡住；碰到宽度合适的同色出口就会滑出。步数用完前清空全部色块即过关。
